attempts.summary: Configured a persistent, source-restricted NFSv4.2 share from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500; the share is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Bidirectional access, denied unauthorized writes, cleanup, and sequential reboot persistence passed. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved.
